text.tspan: COVID-19 vaccine boosters administered per 100 people, 327 to 1202
Total number of vaccine booster doses administered, divided by the total population of the country. Booster
doses are doses administered beyond those prescribed by the original vaccination protocol.
Data source: Official data collated by Our World in Data (2024); World Health Organisation (2025); Population based on various sources
